name: Seeed Studio 320120010 DC Barrel Power Jack & Connector
//: Seeed's bare DC jack, SKU 320120010. The rendered page shows only 'Dimensions: 14', but the page's HTML carries a feature block that states: 'Dimensions: 14.2mm * 9.0mm * 11mm', 'Inner core diameter: ¢ 2.0', 'Rating: 0.5A 30V DC', 'Contact resistance: 100 milliohms max.', 'Operating temperature: -20°C ~ 70°C', 'The operating force: 3-20N', 'The operating life: 5,000 cycles'. USD 0.55, out of stock. No datasheet, no drawing, one photo. Read 2026-09-29 while researching the irrigation controller's 12 V inlet; Seeed was the second module vendor before the seller rule moved connectors to Czech shops.
//why_not: Rated 0.5 A by Seeed's own page - a quarter of the load - and out of stock.
footprint_note: Nothing to draw from: no drawing, no pin count on the page. The stated 14.2 x 9.0 x 11 mm is the DC-005 family's size, which suggests the same three-slot layout - a guess, not a fact.

body_mm.note: Page HTML: 'Dimensions: 14.2mm * 9.0mm * 11mm'. Taken as 14.2 along the plug axis, 9.0 across, 11 tall - the order is the vendor's and which is which is inferred from the DC-005 family.

host_requirements: Do not put more than 0.5 A through it: the vendor's own limit.

rating_current_a.why_it_matters: The number the part was passed over on.

sourcing.note: USD 0.55; 'Out of stock'. Not a Czech seller; here because it was read.
